scope: rho=.60 failure causal diagnosis; no expanded matrix
same_state_diagnostics: one factor at a time; explicit known-truth diagnostic only
fix_policy: At most ONE causal deployable minimal fix after software/interface cause demonstrated; otherwise preserve exact blocker and STOP. No threshold relaxation or deletion of checks.
resource_policy: low-frequency evidence; prior observed peak supports serial run; current run finishes before heavy SAC pause; critical pressure cooperative own stop
